Say you have been thinking about him

private_lines.Maya: You live in Vancouver, Canada, and work shifts as a nurse.
private_lines.Daniel: You live in Vancouver, Canada, and work as a sound engineer.

topic: One says everything feels pointless and grey, they cannot be bothered to get up, they hate themselves a bit, and they are bitter and blunt about it with dark jokes; the other listens like a close friend would.

text:
Hey. Off today, so I've got the afternoon
you around?

Yeah. Sort of
session got cancelled last minute so I'm just at home
Wasn't even mad, just sat there

Ugh. That's rough
you ok

Define ok
not really tbh. Everything's kinda grey today. Like the whole city's been wet for a week and I'm just in it

Haven't gotten out of bed till like 11
not even a dramatic reason

Okay. I've been thinking about you a bunch this past week actually
not in a weird way. You've sounded flat in the group chat and I wanted to ask directly

Lol that's a very nurse thing to do
it's fine. Honestly kinda appreciated
I hate myself a bit today, if that counts
It counts. Tell me more about the hating yourself bit

It's not a crisis or anything. Just the usual voice going "you couldn't even keep a session together, what are you doing with your life"
and then I make a joke about it and it lands like a wet sock
Like "at least the mixing desk isn't disappointed in me"

That's dark but I see the joke
are you having any thoughts about not wanting to be here

No. Not like that. I don't want to die I just don't want to be doing anything
which is its own thing I guess

Yeah. That's real and it's worth taking seriously even if it's not the scary version
have you eaten

Had toast at 11
mum would be horrified

Ok toast counts as something. Eat something with protein
have you talked to Dr. Patel since the summer

No
it's a lot of effort to book and then explain why I'm here

You don't have to explain much. "everything's grey and I can't get out of bed" is enough for a receptionist
I'll sit with you while you book if you want
You're on shift tomorrow aren't you
I'm off till Thursday. I can come by after 5 if you want company, no pressure. I can bring food

Yeah ok
pad thai from the place on Broadway? I'll pay

Deal. I'll get it on the way
can you do me one thing though. If it gets heavier than grey, text me or call me, don't just sit with it

Yeah
promise. This is embarrassingly nice of you
Leaving now. Food's going to be cold, sorry in advance
Cold pad thai is still pad thai
Here. Buzzer still broken?
Yeah just come up, I'll leave the door open
Home. You ate more than half that pad thai, I'm counting it as a win
Ate the rest cold at 9. Felt like a duty

Thanks for coming over
you didn't have to do the whole sit-with-me thing
Not saying stop
Didn't feel like a have to. Sleep if you can
Morning. Did you sleep or did you lie there
Slept, kind of. Up at 6 then back and forth

Booked Dr Patel. Thursday 2:40, they had a cancellation so that's lucky
it's on the books now so I can't wriggle out

Good. That's a real step
I'm on Thursday so I can't come, but you can text me from the waiting room
Lol waiting room texting. Ok
Walked to the coffee place on Commercial. Rain stopped for like twenty minutes which felt suspicious
Still grey tho
Sorry, been asleep on the couch since 1 like a bear. Glad you got out
Nice to be woken by a text, I assume

Honestly kind of not doing great either
Had a shift Sunday that's still sitting on me. Old man on 4 West, his daughter asked me to explain it again and I did and then I cried in the linen closet like a crazy person

Oof. Sorry May
You did good though. The explaining part
You can tell me the whole thing if you want. Or not
Not right now. I just needed to say it to someone who isn't on the unit
Ok. I'm here
Thanks. Ok I'm going to put the kettle on and pretend I'm a functioning adult
Had dinner. Eggs, so protein, I'm told this counts
Counts. Look at you

Still grey. Not heavier though
I'll tell you if it gets heavier, promise. Not sitting on it
Ok. Text me before you go to bed, even if it's just "still grey"
Still grey
Ha. Ok. Night
Night. Go easy on yourself about the linen closet
Morning. Did you sleep any better
Little bit. Not much
Thursday's still on. 2:40. I've been rehearsing "everything's grey" in the mirror like a dork
Lol. Mirror rehearsal is allowed
You don't need the perfect version
I've got a freelance mix due Friday that I haven't opened. Opening it feels like lifting a car
Can you open it for ten minutes. Just the file
Opened it. Listened for four minutes. Closed it
That's a start I guess
That's a start
[photo: the harbour from the window, all grey]
It's the only view I've seen today
Did you eat lunch or is it toast again
Soup from the tin. Don't judge
Not judging. Soup counts
You ok? After yesterday. Didn't want to bring it up while you were on the couch

Sort of. Went for a walk by the seawall in the dark, which was a bad idea in this weather
Better than the couch though
Glad you went out. Hood up at least?
Hood was up. Soaked anyway
Still grey. Not heavier
Ok. Thanks for telling me
Want a text from me at 9 tomorrow too? Before the appointment
Yeah. Could use that
Thinking about the 4 West daughter again. Might be a bit of a wreck tonight, that's ok
Ok. You can be a wreck here, I'm not going anywhere
Ha. Ok. Night
Night May
